description_html:
Key Features

  • Deep Footwall-Drive Fabrication Bay: Engineered with a depth below grade of 160 metres, offering enhanced structural stability and isolation for specialized industrial or mining operations.
  • Spacious Floor Area: Provides 575 square metres of open, adaptable workspace, suitable for various fabrication, assembly, or storage needs.
  • Optimal Occupancy Capacity: Designed to safely accommodate up to 53 people, supporting mid- to large-scale project teams and workflows.
  • Extended Session Length: Allows for operational sessions up to 10 hours, enabling long-duration projects and shift work without interruption.
  • Secure Access Route: Entry is provided via a dedicated stair shaft, ensuring controlled and safe movement of personnel between surface and bay.
  • Flexible Fee Structure: Session fee is determined after acceptance, offering tailored pricing based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Enhanced Safety and Stability: The significant depth below ground level minimizes surface disruptions and provides a controlled environment, ideal for sensitive fabrication or research activities.
  • High Productivity: The large floor area and extended session duration support efficient workflows, allowing teams to maximize output during each booking.
  • Adaptable Workspace: The bay’s size and occupancy limits make it suitable for a wide range of industrial, research, or engineering applications, from equipment assembly to prototype testing.
  • Controlled Access: The stair shaft entry system enhances security and limits unauthorized access, addressing common concerns about facility safety and personnel management.
  • Customizable Pricing: Flexible session fees ensure cost-effectiveness, allowing users to budget based on actual usage and project scale.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Industrial Fabrication: Ideal for heavy machinery assembly, component manufacturing, and precision engineering tasks that require a stable, underground environment.
  • Mining Operations: Suitable for teams needing secure, deep-level bays for equipment storage, maintenance, or operational planning.
  • Research and Development: Provides a controlled setting for scientific experiments, prototype testing, or materials research where environmental consistency is crucial.
  • Training and Team Projects: Accommodates group training sessions, safety drills, or collaborative projects that benefit from ample space and extended access hours.

Frequently Asked User Questions Addressed

  • Durability: Built to withstand underground conditions at 160 metres depth, ensuring long-term reliability and safety.
  • Ease of Use: Clear access via stair shaft, with occupancy and floor space designed for efficient movement and workflow.
  • Compatibility: Suitable for a variety of industrial, research, and team-based activities, supporting diverse project requirements.
  • Value: Session fees are set after acceptance, providing transparency and alignment with specific user needs.

This footwall-drive fabrication bay delivers a secure, spacious, and adaptable underground workspace, designed to meet the demands of modern industrial and research projects.
